in_marathi.name: Aloke
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant or Shining
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aloke हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aloke is derived from the Sanskrit root 'alokah', meaning 'radiant' or 'shining'. In Hindu mythology, Aloke is the name of the god Agni, who represents the divine power of fire. Agni is believed to bring light, knowledge, and purification. The name Aloke is therefore associated with enlightenment, knowledge, and brilliance.
